summary: Bounded supplied-vector CPU query versus CPU and GPU-produced corpus parity, schema fingerprints, ID and digest alignment, cosine/norm diagnostics, raw dot ranking, overlap, score/rank drift and explicit gold recall.
API: qualification.embedding_parity.analyze(mapping): version 1; reference/candidate EmbeddingExecution declarations, query/reference_corpus/candidate_corpus rows with id, input_digest, representation_digest and vector; optional query relevant_ids; k, cosine_tolerance, score_tolerance. Returns structured SUPPLIED_UNVERIFIED evidence; invalid input raises ParityError. Exact bounds and semantics in module docstring.
limitations: Synthetic supplied vectors only; declarations do not prove model execution or hardware qualification. No actual CPU/GPU model, service, network, held-out evaluation or qualification performed. No file loader or CLI included.
